question_stem:
A ball is thrown from a point P with an initial velocity $u$ of $12\ \text{m s}^{-1}$ at $50^{\circ}$ to the horizontal, as illustrated in Fig. 2.1.

{{figure:figure_2_1}}

The ball reaches maximum height at Q.

Air resistance is negligible.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Show that the maximum height reached by the ball is $4.3\ \text{m}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Determine the magnitude of the displacement $PQ$.
